1: Late night in LA: a man suddenly drops onto the roof of a cab that is waiting for a fare.
2: That night, the passenger in an ordinary cabbie's car was a hired killer.
3: At LA airport, a man in a gray suit and sunglasses swaps bags with a stranger and disappears. He would be Max's fare tonight.
4: At the cab company garage. Max wipes his taxi clean again today.
5: Max has driven a cab in LA for twelve years. In front of the driver's seat is a photo of a tropical island, a reminder of the limousine company he dreams of starting someday.
6: Max's cab rolls down the sunset-lit streets of LA. Tonight begins like any other day.
7: His first fare that night is Annie, a federal prosecutor. Max makes a bet with her over the route.
8: Annie tells Max she played a string instrument in high school, opening up to a driver she has just met.
9: Max talks about the limo company he plans to start someday.
10: He says it will be a car so nice you won't want to get out even at the airport. Judging only by Annie's clothes and bag, Max tries to guess what she does for a living.
11: Annie is nervous about tomorrow's first trial, so Max shows her his own secret getaway.
12: As she gets out, Annie hands Max her business card.
13: But Max just sits there holding the card, hesitating.
14: Then comes the next fare: a man in a gray suit, Vincent.
15: Chatting with Max, Vincent brings up a story about a man who died on the subway.
16: Vincent asks how many years Max has been a driver, and Max answers twelve, though it's only temporary work.
17: Vincent says he has five stops to make tonight and offers Max $600 to drive him until dawn.
18: Max waits behind the building. But just then, a man comes plunging from an upstairs window toward the cab.
19: Holding Max at gunpoint, Vincent presses him to open the trunk.
20: Vincent loads the body into the trunk and tells the terrified Max to keep driving.
21: Max can think only of a way out of this nightmare.
22: Meanwhile, Fanning, a narcotics detective, arrives at the apartment where the body fell.
23: The dead man was his informant.
24: Inside the cab, Vincent says calmly, as if it were nothing, that one man dying isn't such a big deal.
26: The cab with the broken windshield gets pulled over by the police.
27: The officer checks the license and peers around inside the cab.
28: Just as they order the trunk opened, a radio call about a shooting comes in, and the cops simply leave.
29: Vincent ties Max's hands to the steering wheel.
30: Then Vincent goes up into the building to deal with his second target, a lawyer.
31: Meanwhile, Max shouts for help to two men passing through the alley.
32: But they rob Max's wallet and Vincent's bag, and Vincent's gun cuts them down.
33: The two stop at a gas station, where Vincent warns Max that drawing attention only gets innocent people killed.
34: Meanwhile, Fanning examines the crime scene.
35: Vincent takes Max into a jazz club.
36: Daniel tells the story of the night he played with Miles Davis.
37: But Daniel's face freezes at what Vincent says next: he is the third target.
38: Vincent says he'll spare Daniel if he answers a question about Miles Davis, but in the end he pulls the trigger.
39: If Max skips his hospital visit, his mother will call the cab company.
40: So Vincent takes Max all the way to his mother's hospital room.
41: In the hospital elevator they pass Detective Fanning, but neither recognizes the other.
42: His mother scolds Max for bringing flowers, but warmly reaches out her hand to Vincent.
43: His mother brags that her son started a limousine company. It was a lie Max had made up for her.
44: The moment he leaves the room, Max snatches Vincent's bag and runs down the stairs.
45: With Vincent chasing him onto the footbridge, Max hurls the bag holding the target list down onto the freeway.
46: As gunshot wounds from the same killer keep turning up, Fanning realizes it is a string of contract killings.
47: When Max brings up his mother as they drive, Vincent tells him a story about his own father.
48: Vincent asks Max, who has been in a temporary job for twelve years, why he still hasn't started.
49: Having lost his list, Vincent tells Max to pose as him and get a new list from Felix, the drug cartel boss who is the client.
50: Fanning goes to FBI agent Pedrosa and tells him about the murders that happened tonight.
51: Max sits down in front of Felix, pretending to be Vincent.
52: When Vincent says he lost the list, Felix tells him a Mexican fairy tale about a creature that carries off bad children.
53: Max is terrified, but he coolly fires back just as Vincent would.
54: Felix hands over the information on the last two targets.
55: But Felix orders his men to take care of Vincent, while Max makes it out of the club safely.
56: A helicopter takes off and the FBI assault team moves out to catch Vincent, but Fanning can't shake the feeling that the cabbie isn't the real killer.
57: Vincent tells Max to call Annie. He says to be sure to do it if he survives.
58: A coyote crosses the road, and Vincent silently stares out the window.
59: Club Fever, where the fourth target is. The FBI, Felix's men, and Vincent all converge at once.
60: Gunfire erupts and the crowd descends into chaos.
61: Detective Fanning tries to lead Max out of the club.
62: But Fanning is soon shot down by Vincent.
63: Vincent puts Max back in the cab.
64: Max shouts back at Vincent for the first time.
65: Max snaps that Vincent is not even human.
66: Telling him to drive downtown for the remaining target, Vincent mocks Max for letting his life slip away while he only dreams.
67: Those words make Max decide to stop Vincent.
68: Instead of slowing down, Max steps on the gas.
69: Max flips the cab right over.
70: While Vincent crawls out of the cab ahead of Max, a police car pulls up.
71: A police officer shines his flashlight over the wrecked cab.
72: Then a laptop screen catches Max's eye.
73: The last target was Annie herself.
74: Needing to go save Annie, Max points a gun at the officer.
75: Max breaks free of the police and runs toward the federal building.
76: He calls Annie, trying to warn her that Vincent is on his way.
77: Annie doesn't believe Max's call, but in the meantime Vincent has already reached her office floor.
78: Max reaches the federal building. The guard is already down, and Max shoots out the glass door.
79: In the dark office, Vincent stalks Annie.
80: Max is riding the elevator up as well.
81: Annie crawls across the dark office floor to evade Vincent.
83: Max hurries Annie toward the elevator.
84: Vincent keeps coming even after being shot. Max and Annie flee into the subway.
85: Covered in blood, Vincent searches the subway cars one by one for the two of them.
86: Max and Vincent come face to face in the subway car and aim their guns at each other.
87: Vincent dies sitting in a subway seat, and Max and Annie walk out of the station into the dawn.
88: That was Collateral, directed by Michael Mann. It drew attention as Tom Cruise's first turn as a cold-blooded villain.
89: It is the story of a cab driver who only dreamed, taking the wheel in a single night. Could you have stood up like Max? Leave it in the comments.
